Bristlecone v1.4.2 — stable Android beta updates

This release retains all of [v1.4.1's preliminary on-device weather learning, fixes and limitations](https://github.com/hayvenmjackson/bristlecone/releases/tag/v1.4.1). The weather model and its single-day pilot limitations are unchanged. The [full pilot evaluation](https://github.com/hayvenmjackson/bristlecone/blob/v1.4.1/tools/weather/evaluations/nws-pilot-2026-10-23.json) records the station and later-hour results.

Android public beta releases now use a persistent signing key. The release workflow requires the key, checks its public certificate fingerprint before building and removes the runner's restored key afterward. Future beta releases using this same key can update v1.4.2 in place. Push and manually triggered development builds remain a separate, temporary-key channel.

**Migrating from Android v1.4.0 or v1.4.1:** those releases used different temporary signing keys whose private keys are unavailable, so Android cannot install v1.4.2 over them. First export a Bristlecone backup and any important track exports, and verify the files are saved somewhere outside the app. Then perform the uninstall/install/restore migration manually when you are ready. Uninstalling removes app-local data; not every device-specific calibration is included in a backup. Bristlecone does not automatically uninstall an earlier version. This signing migration does not apply to iOS.

The new public beta certificate SHA-256 is:

`0ecac4dde2389f7daae0c33b964deb191dae1d23735ca9dba2b64a99f1af623d`

Krummholz retains custody of the private signing key through a protected local copy and an encrypted GitHub Actions secret. Private key material is not included in source, app downloads or build logs. Future maintainers must preserve that key to preserve Android update compatibility.

Downloads:

- Android 8.0+: `Bristlecone-1.4.2-android.apk`.
- iPhone/iPad, iOS 16+: `Bristlecone-1.4.2-ios-unsigned.ipa` (AltStore/SideStore format).
